title: Maximal Cohen–Macaulay property of the first term
statement: Let R be a commutative Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] of finite Krull dimension d [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring], with depth(R) ≥ d [def-weil-pbc-depth]. Let M be a nonzero finite R-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] of depth e, where e ≤ d. For any exact sequence [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence] 0 → K → F_{d-e-1} → ⋯ → F_0 → M → 0 with each F_i finite free [def-weil-pbc-free-module], K is finite and either zero or has depth d. For e=d, exactness identifies K with M, so the conclusion follows from depth(M)=d. The universe-lifted sequence may identify its penultimate object with M by a linear equivalence.

source.place: Algebra, Tags 00NG and 00NE, whose proof refers to 00LX, part (3), and 00LK for the upper bound; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00NG

proof.text: Exactness at object 1 and the zero initial object make S.map' 1 2 injective (ShortComplex.Exact.mono_g and ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective). If d-e>0, object 2 is finite by hfree at index zero; if d=e, its linear equivalence with M makes it finite (Module.Finite.equiv). Module.Finite.of_injective then makes object 1 finite over the Noetherian ring.
Split object 1 into subsingleton or nontrivial. The first branch is the conclusion. In the nontrivial branch apply the lower-depth induction lemma.

For the nontrivial finite object 1, depth_le_supportDim bounds its depth by its support dimension, and Mathlib Module.supportDim_le_ringKrullDim bounds that by ringKrullDim R=d. Combine this upper bound with the lower bound by antisymmetry.

proof_origin.place: Second reading by T3: direct Mathlib finiteness proof and existing support-dimension upper bound; only the lower-depth induction is split off.

theorem first_term_is_maximalCohenMacaulay
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Finite R M] [Nontrivial M]
    (d e : ℕ) (hdim : ringKrullDim R = (d : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hcm : (d : ℕ∞) ≤ depth (R := R) R)
    (he : depth (R := R) M = (e : ℕ∞)) (hed : e ≤ d)
    (S : ComposableArrows (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) (d - e + 3))
    (hS : S.Exact) (hzero0 : IsZero (S.obj' 0))
    (hzero1 : IsZero (S.obj' (d - e + 3)))
    (hM : Nonempty ((S.obj' (d - e + 2)) ≃ₗ[R] M))
    (hfree : ∀ i : Fin (d - e),
      Module.Free R (S.obj' (i.val + 2) (by omega)) ∧
      Module.Finite R (S.obj' (i.val + 2) (by omega))) :
    (let K := S.obj' 1
     ∃ hK : Module.Finite R K,
       letI := hK
       Subsingleton K ∨ depth (R := R) K = (d : ℕ∞))
